name: Avo Echoes of the Void
storyline:
AVO: Echoes of the Void is a story-driven VR puzzle adventure built from the ground up for immersive, hands-on virtual reality.

Your journey begins aboard a failing spacecraft. Moments later, a catastrophic event tears the ship apart, leaving you drifting in the void with no clear answers and no way home.

Awakening inside the wreckage, you must adapt to zero-gravity movement, interact with damaged systems, and explore a mysterious network of interconnected environments. Each space you enter introduces new mechanics, tools, and challenges that build upon one another, encouraging experimentation and mastery rather than one-off solutions.

AVO: Echoes of the Void is not just about solving puzzles. It is about surviving in an unfamiliar environment, learning its rules, and uncovering what lies beyond the void.
